summary: Batch #13 (Family Noticeboard + Customize Dashboard + tappable Home chores + Evening Recap + Edit Profile) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 17/17 pass, 1 skipped by design. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844) walk-through as board@fam.com successful. /api/notices: GET returns seeded 'School closed'/'Plumber visit' notes hydrated with owner + days_until_expiry, pinned-first ordering verified; POST creates & returns 201 with owner card; PATCH toggles pinned/priority; DELETE by owner (Raj) works AND by admin (Raj is admin) deleting a non-Raj-owned notice returns 200; notes past expiry are hidden from GET (verified with expiry_date=yesterday). /api/dashboard/prefs: fresh user returns {order:[],hidden:[],pinned:[],compact:false}; PUT persists per-user (verified via subsequent GET returning saved values) and is isolated per user. PATCH /api/auth/profile: updates user.name AND linked member.name; user.email stays exactly 'board@fam.com'; sending {email: 'hacked...'} is silently ignored (ProfileIn only has 'name') and GET /auth/me confirms email unchanged. PATCH /api/families/members/{id} persists phone and GET returns it. GET /api/home now returns new keys: today_summary {events,chores_done,chores_total,tasks_open,loves_today,posts_today,memories_today} all ints; notices (top active with owner+priority+pinned); kids[].chores each carrying {chore_id,title,stars,done_today}. POST /api/chores/{id}/complete + /uncomplete toggle done_today reflected in GET /api/home. FRONTEND: Login works via login-link-btn -> login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-btn. Home shows 'Family noticeboard' section, seeded 'School closed' note, and 'Open board' action. Open board -> /notice screen, FAB fab-add-notice opens modal, notice-title+notice-note+notice-save creates the note and it appears in the list; delete via notice-del-<id> removes a note (verified admin Raj deleting a note not owned by him — 200 OK). Home header home-customize opens /dashboard/customize; customize-hide-kids + customize-pin-today + customize-compact + customize-save returns to Home where 'Kids & chores' heading is absent (was hidden) and 'Today at a glance' floats above 'Needs your attention' (pinned worked); after full page reload the same layout persists (prefs stored per user). customize-reset + customize-save restores default order. Edit Profile: opened via home-avatar -> /member/{id} -> member-edit pencil -> /member/edit. Screen renders Name, Phone, Birthday inputs plus a distinct Email row that is clearly displayed with a LOCK icon and is non-editable (no TextInput, just AppText). Changing edit-name + edit-phone and pressing edit-save persists and pops back. Deprecated packages: NONE detected in this batch's new files. Console errors: repeated 'A props object containing a "key" prop is being spread into JSX' — this is a react-native-web FlatList/renderItem warning (non-fatal) but it's noisy and should be quietened. NOTE: PATCH /api/families/members/{id} filters out None from body.dict(), so posting {phone: null} does NOT clear phone (silent no-op). Documented as a minor code-review comment.

minor.issue: patch_member drops any field whose value is None (`updates = {k:v for k,v in body.dict().items() if v is not None}`), so callers cannot clear phone/birthday/photo_url/etc. back to null. Recommend using exclude_unset with a model_dump or a sentinel; contrast with set_member_status which explicitly persists None.

react_native_issues.issue: Console repeatedly logs: 'A props object containing a "key" prop is being spread into JSX'. Non-fatal, but should be silenced by passing `key` directly to the JSX element inside renderItem (or wrapping list items so key is not spread). Reference: /app/frontend/app/notice/index.tsx:104-152 (FlatList) and other lists rendered with FlatList on web. Batch #12 also flagged the deprecated `pointerEvents` prop; still present.

action_items: (Minor) Allow PATCH /api/families/members/{id} to clear fields to null (currently None values are stripped so `{phone: null}` is a no-op).
(Nice-to-have) Silence the RN-Web console warnings: (a) 'key prop spread into JSX' inside FlatList renderItem, (b) deprecated `pointerEvents` prop still present.
(Hygiene, ongoing) server.py is 4019 lines — consider splitting Noticeboard/Dashboard-prefs/Profile/Home aggregation into routers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1595 — active-notice filter uses `d['expiry_date'][:10] >= t` where `t = today_str()`. Correct for 'today or later'; matches spec 'past expiry are hidden'.

server.py:1597 — pinned-first sort uses stable sort with `not d.get('pinned')` as key AFTER a created_at-desc sort. Works but relies on Python's stable sort. Consider `sort(key=lambda d: (not d.get('pinned'), -epoch(d['created_at'])))` for clarity.
server.py:1681,1697 — PATCH & DELETE notice permission check: owner OR role in {admin,parent}. Matches spec. 403 message is 'You can't edit/delete this note'.
server.py:590 (patch_member) — strips None values from update dict. Blocks clearing fields; see minor bug.

server.py:617-630 (update_profile) — updates ONLY name; email is never accepted (ProfileIn has no email field). Correct per spec. Silently ignores extra keys because Pydantic model doesn't set extra='forbid'; sending {email: ...} returns 200 with unchanged email — non-security-critical since JWT identifies the user by user_id.
server.py:1481 — kids[].chores includes stars & done_today; matches spec.

server.py:1703-1710 (get_dashboard_prefs) — returns {order,hidden,pinned,compact} defaults on missing doc; per-user (keyed on user_id). No family_id check beyond require_family — a user in family A can't read another user's prefs since the query is on user_id.
server.py:1713-1720 (put_dashboard_prefs) — upsert on user_id with full payload replace. Good.
